title: 第912章 大郎既视感第911章 无以为继
lines: 赵真如对赵真襄的斥责。
让吴谦明知非自愿说出的好人没用，也不由紧张起来。
因为万一算数了呢？
万一赵真襄早就暗恋他，只是当着赵真如的面，不好意思说出来呢？
想到这里，吴谦又生出希望，强忍口中鲜血，眼巴巴的看着赵真襄。
心道你可千万不能再掉链子啊！
胜败在此一举，你若再不好好举的话，我命根点得不到补充，就只能通过命根自己举了！
没有任何意外。
面对赵真如的强迫，赵真襄依旧固执己见，不服气道，
“师父教导我们要遵从本心，师姐怎么能逼我说谎呢！”
“就算他帮了玄阳宫，我说他是好人有什么用，又不是我说他是好人，他就能痊愈了。”
“伤的这么重，却还在意这些名誉，一看就是沽名钓誉之辈，不是诚心悔过，能是什么好人！”
赵真如被说的哑口无言，主要是因为她也觉得，吴谦确实算不上什么好人。
所以饶是她心智过人，也找不到话来回应赵真襄。
可这下也被赵真襄给不小心说中了。
她只有松口承认一句好人，吴谦还真能复原。
吴谦知道，此时若是再努把力，说出好人得益的真相。
加上赵真如在旁相助，说不定真能逼赵真襄就范，来达到好人卡的目的。
但经历过多次绝望，吴谦心中怨气颇深，已经不打算再用这种卑微的办法。
强扭的瓜不甜。
但如果必须强扭的话，吴谦不介意扭的更暴力一些。
方法也很简单，重生换命不行，那就疗伤修复经络。
就像他刚开始想的那样，胜败在此一举，她不举他举！
没有命根值续命，那就用道德值充能。
道德值……可是要比命根好挣多了！
而且羊毛出在羊身上，赵真襄做的孽，也必须由她负责！
因为赵真襄不说好人，而让吴谦去折腾赵真如，虽然……赵真如肯定乐意……
但吴谦也做不出来！
谁让赵真襄她这么油盐不进，放着简单直接的方法白白错过！
“她不付出代价谁付出代价，咱家若是放过她，才是天理不容！”
虽明确了目标，但吴谦也不会傻到恃宠而骄。
content_en:
Zhao Zhenru reprimanded Zhao Zhenxiang.
Wu Qian couldn't help but become nervous even though he knew that the good guy who said it unwillingly was of no use.
Because what if it counts?
What if Zhao Zhenxiang had a crush on him for a long time, but was too embarrassed to say it in front of Zhao Zhenru?
Thinking of this, Wu Qian felt hope again, held back the blood in his mouth, and looked at Zhao Zhenxiang eagerly.
I know in my heart that you must not let your guard down again!
Victory or failure depends on one move. If you don't lift it properly, my life point will not be replenished, and I will have to use my life point to lift it by myself!
No surprises.
Facing Zhao Zhenru's coercion, Zhao Zhenxiang remained stubborn and unconvinced.
"Master teaches us to follow our hearts, how can senior sister force me to lie!"
"Even if he helped Xuanyang Palace, what's the use of me saying he is a good person? It's not like I said he is a good person and he will be cured."
"You're so seriously injured, but you still care about your reputation. You look like a person who is just trying to gain fame. How can he be a good person if he doesn't sincerely repent!"
Zhao Zhenru was left speechless, mainly because she also felt that Wu Qian was indeed not a good person.
So even though she was so smart, she couldn't find the words to respond to Zhao Zhenxiang.
But this time, Zhao Zhenxiang accidentally got it right.
She could only admit that he was a good person, and Wu Qian could really recover.
Wu Qian knew that if he tried harder at this time, he could tell the truth about the benefits to good people.
With Zhao Zhenru helping out, maybe Zhao Zhenxiang can be forced to submit and achieve the goal of being a good guy.
But after experiencing many times of despair, Wu Qian had deep resentment in his heart and no longer planned to use such humble methods.
The twisted melon is not sweet.
But if he had to forcefully twist her, Wu Qian didn't mind twisting him more violently.
The method is also very simple. If rebirth is not enough, then heal the wounds and repair the meridians.
Just like he thought at first, victory or defeat depends on one move, and she won't do it for him!
If there is no life root value to extend your life, then use the moral value to recharge it.
Moral points... are much easier to earn than life points!
Moreover, the wool comes from the sheep, so Zhao Zhenxiang must be held responsible for the evil she did!
Because Zhao Zhenxiang didn't talk about being a good person and let Wu Qian torment Zhao Zhenru, although... Zhao Zhenru would definitely be happy...
But Wu Qian can’t do it either!
Who told Zhao Zhenxiang to be so ignorant that she could use simple and direct methods to miss out!
"If she doesn't pay the price, who will pay the price? It would be unjust for our family to let her go!"
Although his goal is clear, Wu Qian is not stupid enough to be arrogant.
